item.tib: rig 'dzin yab sras rnam gsum thugs sgrubs las brag btsan dmar po'i gsang sgrub
item.coloph: ces pa brag btsan gsang sgrab 'di yang gnas chen shel brag su (tu) sa phag zla ba'i yar tshes la rig 'dzin tshogs gral nas brgyud bzhin lo dus kyi bka' rgya yol nas mad+hal ri khrod la tshe dbang chen po'i (pos) lo tsa'i brda yig gnang byung ba shing sbrul zla tshes la g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang gi rgyal po'i (pos) bod yig tu phab pa'o bkra shis so
item.margin: brag btsan dmar po'i gsang sgrub
